body.name: Bounded non-affine attainable-direction DGP
body.construction: Fix admissible class constants with \(c_\Sigma\le1/2\), \(C_\Sigma\ge1\), and \(B^4\ge(Sd)^2\). Set \(z_0=\tfrac12\mathbf 1_{Sd}\), draw the \(X_{st}\) independently and uniformly on \([0,1]^d\), and take \(\Sigma=\tfrac12I_{Sd}+\tfrac{1}{2Sd}\mathbf 1_{Sd}\mathbf 1_{Sd}^{\top}\). For independent Rademacher vectors \(U_j\in\{-1,1\}^{Sd}\), set \(Z_j=z_0+\Sigma^{1/2}U_j\). Put \(a_0=\min\{B,L,1\}/64\), \(\bar e=(e_1^{\top},0,\ldots,0)^{\top}\), and \(q_0=(\bar e^{\top}\Sigma\bar e)^{1/2}\). Choose \(\delta_0\le\min\{1/2,\{2\|\Sigma\bar e/q_0\|_\infty\}^{-1}\}\) and \(c_{\mathrm{mod}}\le\pi_1a_0\min\{q_0,q_0^{\kappa}\}\). If \(\kappa=1\), set \(m_1(x)=4a_0+a_0(x_1-1/2)+a_0(x_1-1/2)^2\); if \(0<\kappa<1\), set \(m_1(x)=4a_0+a_0(x_1-1/2)_+^{\kappa}-(a_0/2)(1/2-x_1)_+^{\kappa}\); and set \(m_s(x)=4a_0\) for \(s>1\). With mutually independent centered Rademacher noises \(\varepsilon_{sti}\) and \(\eta_{si}\), define \(Q_{sti}=m_s(X_{st})+a_0\varepsilon_{sti}\), \(B_{si}(0)=m_s(z_{0s})+a_0\eta_{si}\), \(B_{si}(1)=B_{si}(0)+a_0\), and \(B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}=B_{si}(1)\). Finally take \(W_{si,-1}=1\), \(R_{si0}(a)=B_{si}(a)-1\), and \(R_{sih}(a)=0\) for \(h>0\). These prescriptions define \(P_{\mathrm{ex}}\).
